native.bitrate: Standard baseline2.5M proposal, rates2.5/5/10M.8M only declared NXP extension, never aggregate A+B rate; no generic positive CAN-style bitrate.
native.payload_bytes: Actual complete frame payload0..254 integer even octets. Word field/static length/local dynamic maximum and prefixes/padding differ; remove8 proposal.
native.fr_profile: PROTOCOL_3_0_1 proposal represented by Vector API; NXP_MFR4310_2_1 actual older controller or DEVICE_SPECIFIC requires source. No automotive generation assumption.
native.fr_configuration_source: Required actual protocol/controller/cluster/node/firmware reference unknown. Public API and manufacturer representations do not prove complete normative conformance.
native.fr_physical_source: Required actual per-channel PHY, cable, star/termination/propagation evidence unknown. No Ethernet PHY/duplex or CAN arbitration fallback.
native.fr_schedule_source: Required actual slot/channel/cycle/owner schedule reference unknown. Scalar validity does not prove slot occupancy, transmission completion or physical startup.
native.fr_segment: Actual STATIC/DYNAMIC unknown; TDMA global fixed payload differs from FTDMA variable local bounded payload.
native.fr_channels: Actual controller A/B/AB unknown. Single-channel actual TX/wakeup must match; AB alone does not mean redundant or twice capacity.
native.fr_tx_channels: Actual A/B/AB TX choice unknown; matches available channel. Per-channel ownership and timing need schedule evidence.
native.fr_channel_use: Actual SINGLE/REDUNDANT/INDEPENDENT unknown. Relationship declared separately from AB connectivity; duplicate traffic not counted as capacity gain.
native.fr_frame_id: Actual11-bit nonzero frame/slot ID1..2047. Static<=static count, dynamic>static count; no arbitraryID1 default.
native.fr_payload_words: Actual7-bit word count0..127; twice count equals actual payload. Static equals global words, dynamic bounded by local maximum.
native.fr_static_payload_words: Actual global static payload word count0..127 unknown, common across cluster. Not local buffer data length; padding may apply.
native.fr_dynamic_payload_words_max: Actual local dynamic maximum word count0..127 unknown; varies per node, not a static global size.
native.fr_frame_bytes: Actual8+payload header/trailer octets8..262. Excludes line coding, TSS/FSS/BSS/FES/DTS and slot wait; not a wire-time certificate.
native.fr_cycle_counter: Actual6-bit cycle counter0..63 bounded by declared cluster maximum. Not fabricated initial0.
native.fr_cycle_count_max: Actual3.0.1 odd maximum7..63 unknown; NXP2.1 fixed63. Lowest tolerated7 is not a universal cluster default.
native.fr_cycle_offset: Actual cycle multiplexing offset0..63, less than repetition and <=cluster counter maximum. No invented initial0.
native.fr_repetition: Actual discrete1/2/4/8/16/32/64-cycle repetition. Not a universal1 default or NIS cycle_ms.
native.fr_transmission_mode: Actual SINGLE_SHOT/CONTINUOUS TX-buffer semantics unknown. Neither is network retransmission or application retry.
native.fr_preamble: Actual header payload-preamble Boolean unknown. Static NMVector/dynamic16-bit message ID meanings differ; null payload cannot claim preamble.
native.fr_payload_valid: Actual null-frame indicator data-valid meaning unknown Boolean. False still has encoded padding/length; never valid device data by default.
native.fr_sync_frame: Actual sync flag unknown Boolean, static only; accepted synchronization requires additional source/controller state.
native.fr_startup_frame: Actual startup flag unknown Boolean, static sync frame of coldstart node. No inferred actual coldstart role.
native.fr_coldstart_node: Actual configured node role unknown Boolean. Counts/roles/live startup evidence not inferred from required static slots.
native.fr_header_crc: Actual11-bit CRC0..2047 unknown. Scalar range is not CRC recomputation over sync/startup/ID/length.
native.fr_frame_crc: Actual24-bit CRC0..16777215 unknown with channel-specific initialization. Scalar range is not accepted frame/integrity proof.
native.fr_crc_source: Actual encoded-frame/channel CRC verification evidence unknown. Header and complete frame CRC are separate mechanisms.
native.fr_nmv_bytes: Actual global NMVector size0..12 octets, must fit static payload when preamble selected. Content/application management semantics require source.
native.fr_message_id: Actual dynamic16-bit preamble MID0..65535 unknown. Not FrameID; absent for static or declared no-preamble.
native.fr_macro_per_cycle: Actual global macroticks8..16000 in Vector3.0.1 representation; NXP2.1 minimum10. Not a configured universal minimum default.
native.fr_macrotick_us: Actual positive global nominal macrotick duration unknown, unit microseconds; controller/network precision constraints require source. Positivity is a declaration check, not a standard lower operating mode.
native.fr_microtick_ns: Actual positive node microtick duration unknown, nanoseconds. NXP MFR4310 fixed50ns at2.5M,25ns at5/8/10M; no general-controller inference from these values.
native.fr_micro_per_cycle: Actual node nominal microticks960..1280000 in Vector API representation; together with microtick equals physical cycle duration. Correction/drift constraints remain device-dependent.

native.fr_cycle_us: Actual positive cluster cycle microseconds; equals macro duration*count and node nominal microticks*duration. Not inherited100ms application requirement.
native.fr_cycle_mt: Actual integer8..16000 complete segment sum, equals macro_per_cycle. Static count*length+dynamic count*length+symbol+NIT; no invented configuration.

native.fr_minislots: Actual dynamic count0..7988 in Vector3.0.1 representation.0 can omit dynamic segment; no optional dynamic traffic invented.

native.fr_sync_frame_ids_max: Actual maximum distinct sync identifiers2..15 in represented profile. IDs, nodes and two-channel duplicates not conflated.
native.fr_allow_halt_clock: Actual halt-on-sync-error flag unknown Boolean. No false safety guarantee or error suppression default.
native.fr_passive_to_active_pairs: Actual consecutive cycle-pair threshold0..31 unknown. POC transitions require runtime state.
native.fr_drift_damping_ut: Actual node damping0..10 microticks in Vector3.0.1 representation. Not CAN ppm or universal correction constant.
native.fr_startup_range_ut: Actual accepted startup deviation29..2743 microticks represented by Vector API; no universal minimum chosen independently of network precision.
native.fr_listen_timeout_ut: Actual node listen1926..2567692 microticks in represented profile. Must be converted with actual microtick, not assumed milliseconds.
native.fr_key_slot_id: Actual0..1023 key slot;0 unconfigured. Active key roles require nonzero static ID.
native.fr_key_only: Actual key-slot-only startup mode unknown Boolean; requires configured key slot.

native.fr_key_sync: Actual key-slot sync flag unknown Boolean; active flag requires valid static key ID.
native.fr_latest_tx: Actual last allowed dynamic minislot0..7988 and <=configured dynamic count. Not FrameID limit or allocated schedule proof.

native.fr_micro_offset_b: Actual B secondary-reference offset0..239 microticks independently configured.
